metadata.name: loss_cover_script
metadata.description: Bordrless Loss cover script: the companion script that pays every holder under water the same fraction of its uncovered loss from the companion's pot, in rounds, reading the Loss cover hook's records. It moves nothing itself: it names, the companion pays and the hook records.

instructions.name: companion_init
docs: The companion's `create_script_v2` calls it once, the creator address signing: the terms
(`init_data`, a [`CoverTerms`]) are written into the state the companion made.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The companion's creator address for the mint, which only the companion signs for.

accounts.name: state
docs: The state the companion made for the mint: `PDA(["script-state", mint])` under the
companion, owned by this program, all zeros.

instructions.name: companion_step
docs: The companion's `script_step` calls it, the creator address signing: the round rolled when
due, every candidate holding measured and its payment named (see the module). Answers the
payouts; `NothingToDo` when there are none.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The companion's creator address for the mint, which only the companion signs for.

accounts.name: companion
docs: The companion of the mint: its pot and its beneficiary.

errors.name: BadTerms
errors.msg: the terms are out of bounds: cover 10% to 100%, a holding and a loss of at least 1, a wait of 30 days at most, rounds of a minute to a day, a minimum pot of 100 SOL at most

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: an account is of another mint

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: an account is not the one expected

errors.name: NoTerms
errors.msg: the companion's payout terms for the mint were not passed

errors.name: NothingToDo
errors.msg: nothing to measure or pay in this batch

errors.name: NoLegs
errors.msg: a coin quoted in tokens: pass its Legs and the companion's legs (CompanionLegs)

types.name: Companion
docs: `PDA(["companion", mint])`.

fields.name: creator_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["creator", mint])`, the launch's creator.

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Who launched it: receives the beneficiary's part of the fees and the vested dev bag.

fields.name: bounty_bps
docs: What a step pays whoever sends it, of what it moves (at most `MAX_BOUNTY_BPS`).

fields.name: max_buyback
docs: The most one buyback spends (lamports of bridged SOL).

fields.name: buyback_interval
docs: The least time between buybacks.

fields.name: vest_secs
docs: The dev bag vests linearly over this many seconds from the launch (0: at once).

fields.name: dev_tokens
docs: Tokens bought for the dev bag, and released to the beneficiary so far.

fields.name: pending_buyback
docs: Bridged SOL held for each purpose (in the creator's holding).

fields.name: claimed_total
docs: Running totals.

fields.name: reference_price
docs: The buyback's reference price (quote per base unit times `PRICE_SCALE`), set at the launch and
moved toward the pool's price by at most `REFERENCE_STEP_BPS` at a time, once an interval.

fields.name: game_hook
docs: The game's token hook (`create_game`); the default key for a companion without a game.

fields.name: pot_bps
docs: The pot's part of every fee claim, next to `split` (the four sum to 10,000).

fields.name: pending_pot
docs: Bridged SOL held for the game's pot (in the creator's holding).

fields.name: round_secs
docs: The game's round length, which its hook's header must state (checked at the launch).

fields.name: stranded_burned_at
docs: When `burn_stranded` last burned a blocked game's buyback, a blocked game's pot last moved
into the buyback (by any step: `enforce_terms`), or a blocked game's fee claim last credited
the buyback at least what it held (`Companion::restart_stranded_wait`) (0: never): the
next burn waits its whole period from here, so a pot moved, or a share credited to a
buyback that had spent what it was given, is never burned before keepers have had that
long to spend it.

fields.name: game_kind
docs: The game's kind (`create_game`), which the launch checks the hook's flags and header by.

fields.name: pot_locked
docs: The part of `pending_pot` a closed streak epoch still owes its holders: a cap lowered since
never trims it (`steps::enforce_terms`), and only a block moves it to the buyback. Zero for
every other kind.

fields.name: mode
docs: `MODE_CLASSIC`, `MODE_SNOWBALL` or `MODE_SCRIPT` (2026-10-12), the last byte of what was
`reserved`: zero, classic, in every companion made before.

fields.name: quote_cut_claimed
docs: How much of the launch's `quote_cut_accrued` (the hook's SOL cut, paid into the creator fee
vault with the creator fee) this companion's fee claims have taken: what a claim takes
beyond it, up to the whole claim, is the hook's and goes to the pot's bucket.

fields.name: native_sol
docs: Whether the companion's SOL is lamports on its creator address (`crate::instructions::native`)
rather than bridged SOL in the creator's holding.

types.name: CoverAnswer
docs: The Borsh of a PayoutAnswer (version 1, a SOL coin) or a PayoutAnswerLegs (version 3, a coin quoted in tokens): read the first byte.

fields.name: version
docs: 1 or 3; the entries follow as that version's.

types.name: CoverRound
docs: A round rolled: its budget and the loss measured over the round before, which fix the round's
fraction `min(1, b / l_prev)`.

types.name: CoverRoundLeg
docs: A leg's round rolled on a coin quoted in tokens: its budget `b` and the loss `l_prev` measured
on the leg the round before, in the leg's token.

types.name: CoverState
docs: The script's state, `PDA(["script-state", mint])` under the companion, 128 bytes: the terms,
written once by `companion_init`, then the rounds.

fields.name: round
docs: The round of the last step (0 before the first).

fields.name: b
docs: The round's budget: the pot at its first step.

fields.name: l_prev
docs: The uncovered loss measured over the previous round.

fields.name: l_cur
docs: Measured so far this round.

fields.name: round_paid
docs: Paid so far this round.

fields.name: measured
docs: Holdings measured this round.

fields.name: rounds
docs: Rounds stepped so far.

fields.name: paid_total
docs: Paid all time.

types.name: GameKind
docs: The kinds of game a companion runs. Borsh writes the variant's index, so a kind added later is
appended and every game made before keeps its own (a companion made before phase 2 reads 0,
the lottery, in `Companion.game_kind`).

types.name: NativeSol
docs: A bool (1 byte); absent (read as false) in a companion not grown for it.

types.name: QuoteCutClaimed
docs: A u64; absent (read as 0) in a companion account made before 2026-10-15.

types.name: Split
docs: What every creator fee claim pays for, in basis points summing to 10,000.

fields.name: buyback_bps
docs: Bought back on the token's own pool and burned.

fields.name: holders_bps
docs: Streamed to holders through the kit's reward pool.

fields.name: beneficiary_bps
docs: Accrued to the beneficiary, who is paid it as SOL.
